prompts.title: 3D Paper Quilling Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed, luxury-quality quilling paper portrait of a young male subject, designed in a richly handcrafted paper-strip style inspired by premium 3D quilling art. The character should appear handsome, masculine, and naturally appealing, with a completely original composition and presence.

Subject Appearance

Depict a charming young man with:

thick, naturally wavy, slightly messy voluminous dark hair
deep expressive eyes
strong, well-shaped eyebrows
a sculpted straight nose
defined cheekbones
a sharp masculine jawline
a well-groomed appearance

His expression should feel warm, confident, and softly smiling, with realistic facial proportions and an attractive charismatic look.

Artistic Style

Render the entire portrait as an intricate handmade quilling artwork, built from thousands of individually shaped paper strips.

Use:

curled strips
rolled coils
folded paper ribbons
layered filigree details
delicate swirling paper forms

The paper elements should remain clearly visible and handcrafted while forming the face, hair, beard, eyes, lips, shadows, highlights, and clothing with realistic depth.

Color Palette

Use a bold and elegant palette that includes:

burnt orange
golden yellow
crimson red
magenta
deep violet
turquoise
electric blue
black
ivory
soft white accents

These colors should be blended artistically throughout the portrait while still preserving a refined premium look.

Hair & Facial Detail

The hair should be especially rich and dimensional, made from layered dark paper strips with flowing curls and subtle colored accents woven through it.

The face should show highly detailed paper construction, with the paper strips shaping:

facial contours
skin texture
eyelids and eyes
nose structure
lips
beard texture if present
light and shadow transitions
Clothing

Dress the subject in an elegant ivory textured shirt or jacket, fully constructed in ornate cream-toned paper filigree.

The clothing should feature refined decorative quilling patterns that add a luxurious contrast to the vibrant face without overpowering it.

Composition
vertical portrait
centered framing
head-and-shoulders composition
face occupying most of the frame
mostly frontal pose
balanced and symmetrical presentation
clean pure white background
subtle soft shadow around the artwork
Finish & Presentation

The final image should feel like a premium gallery-quality paper sculpture portrait, photographed with refined studio lighting.

Emphasize:

crisp paper edges
intricate micro-details
visible curled paper fibers
layered 3D relief
realistic dimensional depth
polished fine-art presentation
extremely sharp high-resolution detail
Signature

Place a tasteful handwritten artist signature at the bottom-right corner reading exactly:

“PromptPlum”

Use a refined black calligraphic style with a thin minimalist underline.

Final Style Keywords

Ultra-realistic quilling paper portrait, handcrafted paper filigree, layered 3D paper relief, intricate curled strips, vibrant fine-art detailing, sophisticated composition, premium studio presentation, masterpiece, 8K detail.

prompts.title: Textured Impasto Portrait of a Woman
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic digital oil portrait of the uploaded female subject, preserving her natural facial features, skin tone, eye colour, hairstyle, and overall identity with high accuracy.
Show her from the upper shoulders upward in a graceful three-quarter side profile, looking thoughtfully into the distance with a calm, elegant expression. Keep the facial anatomy natural and well-defined, with realistic skin texture, softly detailed eyes, subtle makeup, and natural highlights on the lips.
Style her hair in a loose, sophisticated messy bun with natural volume, soft flyaway strands, and a few wispy locks framing her face and neck. Dress her in a minimalist deep-black V-neck blouse made from soft matte fabric.
Use a warm abstract oil-painted background with expressive palette-knife strokes in ivory, cream, beige, sand, warm ochre, soft peach, and muted gold. Include visible impasto texture and handcrafted brush marks while keeping the background secondary to the subject.
Illuminate one side of her face with soft, warm directional light, creating gentle highlights across the forehead, nose, cheekbones, lips, and neck, with smooth natural shadows for dimensional depth.
Vertical 4:5 composition, centered framing, head, neck, and upper shoulders visible, with comfortable negative space around the subject. Contemporary fine-art portrait, painterly realism, realistic anatomy, rich colour harmony, detailed oil-brush texture, warm neutral palette, refined museum-quality finish.

prompts.title: Impasto Portrait in Shades of Purple
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for the female face and identity reference. Preserve the same facial identity, facial structure, facial proportions, age, skin tone, and natural likeness accurately. Do not copy the reference image’s clothing, pose, background, hairstyle, accessories, lighting, or environment. Only the face and identity should change according to the uploaded female reference; everything else must follow the prompt exactly.
Create an ultra-detailed 3D sculptural portrait rendered in a heavy impasto tactile style, blending hyper-realistic 3D rendering with thick oil paint textures. The subject is a beautiful young woman shown in a serene left-facing side profile, with her head gently tilted downward and a calm, introspective expression.
She has dark, glossy hair tied back in a loose, slightly messy ponytail, with a few soft strands falling naturally around her face. Her skin has a smooth, subtle glow, enhanced with soft pink makeup and softly tinted pink lips. She delicately holds a small bouquet of vivid purple flowers in both hands close to her chest, creating a quiet, emotional, contemplative mood.
She wears a simple white sleeveless tank top with minimal detailing, painted with thick visible brush strokes to enhance the tactile sculptural quality.
Environment and Composition:
The subject must appear strictly as a mural painted on a vertical wall surface. The artwork is clearly confined within the wall boundaries and must not extend onto the ground, sidewalk, or any horizontal surface.
The wall behind her is a rich lavender-purple tone with visible plaster texture, expressive palette-knife marks, and thick impasto brush strokes. Above her, a lush canopy of vibrant purple bougainvillea flowers spreads across the top of the frame, growing from a slender, slightly curved tree trunk on the left side.
Subtle fallen petals are scattered along the real ground at the base of the wall, adding realism and depth. The composition is vertically framed from mid-torso up, with the woman placed slightly right of center so the tree trunk and floral canopy balance the frame naturally.
The ground below must remain real, unpainted, and separate from the mural, showing a natural sidewalk surface with a few scattered petals. No part of the painted woman, flowers, clothing, or brush strokes should overlap onto the ground.
Camera and Perspective:
Eye-level camera angle, straight-on perspective. The wall must be perfectly vertical and parallel to the camera sensor, with no tilt, distortion, warped perspective, or perspective skew.
Lighting:
Bright, direct natural sunlight comes from the upper right, creating strong highlights and sharp dramatic shadows. The bougainvillea flowers cast intricate dappled shadows across the lavender wall, the woman’s face, neck, shoulder, and tank top. The lighting should strongly emphasize the thickness, depth, and direction of every impasto brush stroke.
Style and Texture:
Highly tactile sculptural impasto style with exaggerated visible paint strokes across the skin, clothing, flowers, hair, and background. The final image should feel like a fusion of thick oil painting, 3D sculpture, and hyper-realistic rendering — dimensional, premium, cinematic, and almost touchable.
Technical Details:
8K resolution, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, Octane Render, global illumination, high dynamic range, masterpiece quality, ultra-realistic textures, premium 3D oil-paint mural aesthetic.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5
